objective: Auditar exclusivamente en EDARSAHUB SQL las cinco conexiones API_LOCAL con EmpresaID nulo y construir evidencia canónica actual usando únicamente columnas verificadas de Servidores_Conexiones, Sistema_EmpresasServidores, Sistema_Empresas y Unidades_Negocio. Descubrir además el esquema de Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo antes de cualquier uso. No inferir EmpresaID, no mutar datos y no tocar Producción.

queries.name: target_api_local_rows
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.nombre, sc.system_type, sc.tipo_conexion, sc.EmpresaID AS current_EmpresaID, sc.empresa_id AS legacy_empresa_id_text, sc.sucursales, sc.activo, sc.visible_en_operaciones, sc.visible_en_listado FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc WHERE sc.id IN ('b597d88a-ab37-4b4e-897b-efe68c9b3732','8cbdcc89-6495-49c3-be9c-a965db82c77f','d8b2d1eb-2e1f-4e43-b7d9-822bf671e315','31d62f39-632b-4684-b735-256bd9293a8f','2bead18c-73c9-4d86-af92-2355940274f7') ORDER BY sc.nombre

queries.name: target_mapping_via_empresas_servidores
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.nombre, sc.EmpresaID AS current_EmpresaID, ses.EmpresaID AS mapped_EmpresaID, se.CodigoEmpresa, se.NombreEmpresa, se.NombreComercial, se.Activo AS empresa_activa, ses.RolConexion, ses.NombreSucursalSistema, ses.EsPrincipal, ses.Activo AS mapping_activo FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores ses ON ses.ServidorID = sc.id LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas se ON se.EmpresaID = ses.EmpresaID WHERE sc.id IN ('b597d88a-ab37-4b4e-897b-efe68c9b3732','8cbdcc89-6495-49c3-be9c-a965db82c77f','d8b2d1eb-2e1f-4e43-b7d9-822bf671e315','31d62f39-632b-4684-b735-256bd9293a8f','2bead18c-73c9-4d86-af92-2355940274f7') ORDER BY sc.nombre, ses.Activo DESC, ses.EsPrincipal DESC, ses.EmpresaID

queries.name: target_mapping_cardinality
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.nombre, sc.EmpresaID AS current_EmpresaID, COUNT(ses.EmpresaServidorID) AS mappings_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mappings_activos, SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 AND ses.EsPrincipal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mappings_activos_principales, MAX(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 AND ses.EsPrincipal = 1 THEN ses.EmpresaID END) AS candidate_principal_EmpresaID, MAX(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN ses.EmpresaID END) AS candidate_any_active_EmpresaID, CASE WHEN sc.EmpresaID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALREADY_HAS_EMPRESAID' WHEN COUNT(ses.EmpresaServidorID) = 0 THEN 'NO_MAPPING_FOUND' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'ONLY_INACTIVE_MAPPINGS' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 AND ses.EsPrincipal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'CANDIDATE_FROM_ACTIVE_PRIMARY_MAPPING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ses.Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'CANDIDATE_FROM_SINGLE_ACTIVE_MAPPING' ELSE 'AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_MAPPINGS' END AS mapping_verdict FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores ses ON ses.ServidorID = sc.id WHERE sc.id IN ('b597d88a-ab37-4b4e-897b-efe68c9b3732','8cbdcc89-6495-49c3-be9c-a965db82c77f','d8b2d1eb-2e1f-4e43-b7d9-822bf671e315','31d62f39-632b-4684-b735-256bd9293a8f','2bead18c-73c9-4d86-af92-2355940274f7') GROUP BY sc.id, sc.nombre, sc.EmpresaID ORDER BY sc.nombre

queries.name: target_unidades_by_server_id
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.nombre AS connection_name, un.id AS unidad_id, un.codigo AS unidad_codigo, un.nombre AS unidad_nombre, un.server_id AS unidad_server_id, un.sucursal_origen_id, un.system_type AS unidad_system_type, un.activo AS unidad_activa FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio un ON TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, un.server_id) = sc.id WHERE sc.id IN ('b597d88a-ab37-4b4e-897b-efe68c9b3732','8cbdcc89-6495-49c3-be9c-a965db82c77f','d8b2d1eb-2e1f-4e43-b7d9-822bf671e315','31d62f39-632b-4684-b735-256bd9293a8f','2bead18c-73c9-4d86-af92-2355940274f7') ORDER BY sc.nombre, un.codigo

queries.name: sucursal_servidor_mapeo_schema
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: sistema_empresas_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT EmpresaID, CodigoEmpresa, NombreEmpresa, NombreComercial, RFC, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_Empresas ORDER BY EmpresaID

acceptance_criteria: No EmpresaID inferred without SQL evidence
